  function duration(i) {
    return (i === times.length - 1 ? period : times[i + 1]) - times[i];

  function tangent(a,b) {
    return a*b <= 0 ? 0 : 2*a*b/(a+b);

  function sample(table,i,u) {

    const p = (i+n-1)%n, j = (i+1)%n, k = (i+2)%n;

    const u2 = u*u, u3 = u2*u;
    return table[i].map((a,c) => {
      const b = table[j][c], slope = (b-a)/h;
      const m0 = tangent((a-table[p][c])/h0,slope);
      const m1 = tangent(slope,(table[k][c]-b)/h2);

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const times = [0,160,340,500,680,840,1020,1180];
  const period = 1200;
  const rows = strings => strings.map(s => s.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number));
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);

  // Each wing contour starts at the wrist and follows the same seven
  // cubic segments around the arm in every pose.
  const leftArm = rows([
    `54 91  56 80 69 77 78 86  82 90 85 97 87 103
     89 112 88 124 85 137  82 149 79 157 73 162
     66 168 59 166 53 162  45 157 41 148 38 138
     34 125 43 104 54 91`,

     30 165 23 162 20 157  16 151 16 142 15 134
     13 125 11 116 12 109`,
    `47 98  50 86 63 83 72 91  77 96 80 99 83 103
     87 114 84 127 81 137  77 150 73 157 66 162
     59 166 51 164 46 158  39 151 36 143 35 135
     33 123 39 109 47 98`,
    `8 97  8 85 20 82 28 94  34 105 49 90 62 84
     69 90 62 111 54 127  48 140 40 150 33 153
     24 156 17 152 13 147  8 140 8 130 8 122
     7 111 7 103 8 97`,
    `30 121  32 109 45 106 54 113  60 118 66 110 74 107
     80 118 74 140 69 153  65 166 60 176 53 179
     45 183 38 177 34 171  30 166 30 157 30 150
     30 138 27 129 30 121`
  ]);

  const rightArm = rows([
    `196 82  189 83 184 95 185 110  186 124 189 137 195 146
     200 155 208 155 216 151  226 147 233 142 231 131
     230 121 226 112 224 103  221 91 216 82 209 80
     204 77 200 79 196 82`,
    `145 92  137 96 138 110 142 124  146 140 154 153 166 160
     176 167 185 170 194 164  205 157 213 141 212 126
     212 111 207 102 201 94  191 84 180 77 169 78
     159 79 150 85 145 92`,
    `197 94  189 96 186 107 187 119  188 133 192 147 197 155
     202 164 210 165 218 160  227 156 234 149 232 138
     231 128 227 119 225 112  222 103 218 96 211 92
     206 89 200 91 197 94`,
    `177 119  168 122 165 134 168 148  169 161 175 175 182 181
     188 187 196 189 204 182  215 175 221 162 219 149
     218 137 212 127 208 119  202 110 194 102 187 104
     182 106 178 113 177 119`,
    `166 103  157 106 154 120 157 134  159 148 166 161 176 168
     184 175 193 177 202 172  213 165 221 152 220 139
     220 128 214 115 208 108  199 97 189 89 180 90
     174 90 169 97 166 103`,
    `197 94  190 95 184 104 185 116  186 130 190 144 196 153
     201 161 210 162 217 158  226 155 232 147 230 137
     229 127 226 118 224 111  222 102 218 95 211 92
     206 89 201 90 197 94`,
    `160 108  152 110 149 124 152 137  155 150 164 164 174 171
     183 177 193 178 200 173  211 166 218 153 216 139
     215 126 210 117 204 109  196 100 185 92 176 93
     169 94 163 101 160 108`,
    `196 112  187 114 182 126 183 139  184 153 188 165 195 172
     201 179 210 178 218 172  228 167 234 159 232 149
     231 138 227 129 224 122  221 113 217 107 210 106
     204 105 199 107 196 112`
  ]);

  // Position of the top of each brown tip, followed by its local basis.
  const leftTip = [
    [68,73,1,0,0,1], [16,55,.74,0,-.045,1.08],
    [54,88,1.07,-.04,.07,1], [21,94,.90,-.02,.065,1.05],
    [20.5,87,.85,-.02,.03,1], [59.5,77,1.09,-.025,.06,.98],
    [18.5,74,.86,.03,-.035,1.11], [42,99,1.05,0,.08,.99]
  ];
  const rightTip = [
    [212,61,1,0,0,1], [150,77,1.33,.06,.40,.97],
    [211,74,1.03,-.02,.015,1], [187,103,1.23,-.035,.07,1],
    [172,88,1.29,0,.22,1.02], [211.5,74,1,-.02,-.035,.96],
    [168,94,1.36,.04,.19,.92], [207.5,92,1.08,-.02,.09,1.02]
  ];

  // Eye midpoint, head tilt, shoulder sway, shoulder drop, hip drop,
  // and the horizontal position of the light on the left wing.
  const posture = [
    [124,23.15,0,0,0,0,.29],
    [125.5,24.1,13.2,-3,1.5,1,.74],
    [125.4,27.8,.4,.3,5,1.2,.29],
    [124.1,35.2,9,-2.6,12.5,4,.71],
    [125.2,30.1,8.9,-2.4,7.8,2.2,.67],
    [124.2,25.45,2.3,-.6,2.4,.8,.31],
    [125.1,30,9.4,-2.5,7.3,1.8,.72],
    [125.2,34,5.3,-.8,11.5,3.8,.39]
  ];

  function duration(i) {
    return (i === times.length - 1 ? period : times[i + 1]) - times[i];
  }
  function tangent(a,b) {
    return a*b <= 0 ? 0 : 2*a*b/(a+b);
  }
  function sample(table,i,u) {
    const n = times.length;
    const p = (i+n-1)%n, j = (i+1)%n, k = (i+2)%n;
    const h = duration(i), h0 = duration(p), h2 = duration(j);
    const u2 = u*u, u3 = u2*u;
    return table[i].map((a,c) => {
      const b = table[j][c], slope = (b-a)/h;
      const m0 = tangent((a-table[p][c])/h0,slope);
      const m1 = tangent(slope,(table[k][c]-b)/h2);
      return a + (3*u2-2*u3)*(b-a) + h*((u3-2*u2+u)*m0+(u3-u2)*m1);
    });
  }

  function matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f) {
    return `matrix(${a} ${b} ${c} ${d} ${e} ${f})`;
  }
  function tipPose(values,x0,y0) {
    const [x,y,a,b,c,d] = values;
    return matrix(a,b,c,d,x-a*x0-c*y0,y-b*x0-d*y0);
  }
  function contour(v) {
    return `M${v[0]} ${v[1]}C${v.slice(2).join(" ")}Z`;
  }
  function render(t) {
    const time = ((t%period)+period)%period;
    let i = 0;
    while (i+1 < times.length && times[i+1] <= time) i++;
    const u = (time-times[i])/duration(i);
    const [x,y,angle,sway,drop,hips,light] = sample(posture,i,u);
    const r = angle*Math.PI/180;
    const a = Math.cos(r), b = Math.sin(r), c = -.33*b;
    el("head").setAttribute("transform",matrix(a,b,c,a,
      x-a*124-c*23.15, y-b*124-a*23.15));

    const lean = -sway/190;
    const sy = 1-(drop-hips)/190;
    const bodyPose = matrix(1,0,lean,sy,-240*lean,240*(1-sy)+hips);
    el("torso").setAttribute("transform",bodyPose);
    el("shadow-boundary").setAttribute("transform",bodyPose);
    el("left-wing-outline").setAttribute("d",contour(sample(leftArm,i,u)));
    el("right-wing-outline").setAttribute("d",contour(sample(rightArm,i,u)));
    el("left-wing-color").setAttribute("cx",light);

    const l = tipPose(sample(leftTip,i,u),68,73);
    const h = tipPose(sample(rightTip,i,u),212,61);
    el("left-wingtip").setAttribute("transform",l);
    el("right-wingtip").setAttribute("transform",h);
    el("left-tip-shadow").setAttribute("transform",l);
    el("right-tip-shadow").setAttribute("transform",h);
  }
  window.nwb = {render};
  render(0);
}, {once:true});
</script>
